title: Reinstatement, Appeal and Delisting Notice Periods by Class
content:
Where a Keyturn Vehicle Listing has been suspended or is to be taken down, four periods run, and each class publishes its own.

| Class | Reinstatement window (calendar days) | Reinstatement review (business days) | Appeal period (calendar days) | Delisting notice (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Economy Class Listing | 30 | 3 | 14 | 3 |
| Keyturn Standard Class Listing | 30 | 3 | 14 | 3 |
| Keyturn Premium Class Listing | 45 | 2 | 21 | 7 |
| Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | 45 | 2 | 21 | 7 |
| Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | 60 | 5 | 30 | 14 |
| Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing | 45 | 4 | 21 | 7 |

The reinstatement window, the appeal period and the delisting notice are counted in whole calendar days; the reinstatement review is counted in business days. In every class the appeal period is longer than the reinstatement review, and in no class is the delisting notice longer than the reinstatement window.
